wellness_responses.respuesta: It's completely normal to feel overwhelmed during a career transition. Many professionals experience this. Let's break down your transition into smaller, manageable weekly goals. You're not alone in this journey.
wellness_responses.accion_sugerida: Schedule a 15-min wellness session this week

wellness_responses.respuesta: You're doing better than you think! The stress you're feeling shows you care about your career growth. Let's focus on one skill at a time. You've overcome challenges before.
wellness_responses.accion_sugerida: Complete one micro-course (< 1 hour) this week

wellness_responses.respuesta: Your stress level is high, but remember: you have the capability to manage this. Your confidence shows you've overcome similar situations. Let's channel this energy into learning.
wellness_responses.accion_sugerida: Join a peer support group with similar career changers

wellness_responses.respuesta: You're progressing, and that's what matters. Low confidence is common when learning new skills. Remember: every expert was once a beginner. One step at a time.
You're on a solid path! You're managing the transition well. Keep up the momentum. Your skills are growing every day, even if you don't notice it yet.
wellness_responses.accion_sugerida: Share your progress with a peer or mentor

wellness_responses.respuesta: You're balancing transition stress very well! Your confidence is your strength. You're ready for the next level of learning. Consider mentoring someone else in your current skills.
wellness_responses.accion_sugerida: Take an advanced course or earn a new certification

wellness_responses.respuesta: You're in a great mindset for learning! Even with lower confidence, you're showing great composure. Trust the process. Small consistent steps lead to big changes.
wellness_responses.accion_sugerida: Revisit your transition roadmap and celebrate progress

wellness_responses.respuesta: Excellent state of mind! You're calm and building confidence steadily. This is the ideal mindset for successful career transition. Keep learning at your pace.
wellness_responses.accion_sugerida: Apply for an internship or freelance project in your target field

wellness_responses.respuesta: You're in the ideal state for career transformation! Calm, confident, and learning. This is exactly the mindset that leads to successful transitions. You're ready to make the leap.
wellness_responses.accion_sugerida: Start applying for positions in your target occupation

wellness_responses.respuesta: Congratulations! You've completed a major milestone in your transition. This achievement proves you're capable of transformation. Celebrate this moment—you've earned it!
wellness_responses.accion_sugerida: Share your achievement with your support network

wellness_responses.respuesta: We've noticed you haven't engaged recently. Career transitions are challenging, but you started for a reason. Remember: progress isn't always linear. Would you like to adjust your plan to be more manageable?
It's wonderful you have family support during this transition! Share your progress with them regularly. Their encouragement can be a powerful motivator for reaching your goals.
wellness_responses.accion_sugerida: Set weekly check-in with family members
